command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
sha256sum -c fixture.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the staged fixture does not match its pins"; exit 1; }
AD1=AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCAC
AD2=AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT
# Mode matched to the cutadapt run: the same adapter sequences, no quality/length/N filter,
# no polyG, one thread. fastp's paired-end overlap analysis stays on -- it is how fastp trims PE.
fastp -i R1.fq -I R2.fq -o fastp_R1.fq -O fastp_R2.fq \
      --adapter_sequence "$AD1" --adapter_sequence_r2 "$AD2" \
      -Q -L -G -w 1 -j fastp.json -h fastp.html > fastp.log 2>&1; RC=$?
echo "fastp rc $RC"; tail -5 fastp.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: fastp did not finish"; exit 1; }
N1=$(awk 'END{print NR/4}' fastp_R1.fq); N2=$(awk 'END{print NR/4}' fastp_R2.fq)
echo "fastp wrote $N1 / $N2 reads of 1890 pairs (it drops inserts under 3 bp even with -L)"
test "$N1" = "$N2" && test "$N1" -gt 0 || { echo "FAIL: fastp output is empty or unpaired"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo DONE
